relationships.subject: KN-93
relationships.evidence_quote: these alterations were all reversed by intrathecal injection of KN-93 (a CaMKII inhibitor)

relationships.subject: Connexin-43
relationships.evidence_quote: knocking down or inhibiting Cx43 level via intrathecal injection of Cx43 siRNA or Gap27 (a Cx43 mimetic peptide) relieved pain hypersensitivity and reduced the release of inflammatory factors

relationships.subject: CaMKII
relationships.evidence_quote: we demonstrated that the CaMKII signalling pathway was involved in VCR-induced inflammation, apoptosis, and mitochondrial damage

key_findings: Vincristine neuropathic pain involves astrocyte activation with p-CaMKII, CaV3.2 and Cx43 upregulation; CaMKII and CaV3.2 inhibition reverses these changes.
Cx43 mediates inflammatory factor release downstream, without affecting astrocyte activation or p-CaMKII/CaV3.2.
